questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The company asked its engineers to install a new AI security system.
options: A. The company had its engineers install a new AI security system.
B. The company had a new AI security system installed by its engineers.
C. The engineers made the company install a new AI security system.
D. The company made install a new AI security system by its engineers.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: have + O + V-inf → nhờ ai làm gì (chủ động). Dịch nghĩa: Công ty nhờ các kỹ sư của mình lắp đặt một hệ thống bảo mật AI mới.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The developer made the AI system learn faster through new data.
options: A. The AI system was made learn faster through new data.
B. The AI system was made to learn faster through new data.
C. The AI system made to learn faster through new data.
D. The developer was made learn faster through new data.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: make sb do sth → be made to do sth (bị động). Dịch nghĩa: Hệ thống AI được lập trình để học nhanh hơn nhờ dữ liệu mới.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. They got a specialist to improve the facial recognition feature.
options: A. They had the facial recognition feature improved by a specialist.
B. They made the specialist improved the facial recognition feature.
C. They got the facial recognition feature to be improved.
D. They were made improve the facial recognition feature.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: have/get + O + P.P → bị động Dịch nghĩa: Họ nhờ chuyên gia cải thiện tính năng nhận diện khuôn mặt.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The AI team asked the programmer to rewrite the algorithm.
options: A. The programmer was asked rewrite the algorithm.
B. The programmer was asked to rewrite the algorithm.
C. The programmer asked to rewrite the algorithm.
D. The programmer was made rewrite the algorithm.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: ask sb to V → S is asked to V (bị động). Dịch nghĩa: Lập trình viên được yêu cầu viết lại thuật toán.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. They got the software engineer to fix the security bug.
options: A. They had the software engineer fix the security bug.
B. They had the security bug fixed by the software engineer.
C. They made the software engineer fixed the security bug.
D. They got the security bug fix by the software engineer.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: get + O + to V = have + O + V-inf (nhờ ai làm gì). Dịch nghĩa: Họ nhờ kỹ sư phần mềm sửa lỗi bảo mật.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The scientist made the robot speak with a human-like voice.
options: A. The robot was made to speak with a human-like voice.
B. The robot made speak with a human-like voice.
C. The robot was made speak with a human-like voice.
D. The scientist had the robot to speak with a human-like voice.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: make sb do sth → be made to do sth. Dịch nghĩa: Con robot được lập trình để nói bằng giọng giống con người.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The AI lab asked engineers to test the new data system.
options: A. The AI lab had engineers tested the new data system.
B. The AI lab had engineers test the new data system.
C. The AI lab made engineers testing the new data system.
D. The AI lab got the new data system tested engineers.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: have + O + V-inf → nhờ ai làm gì (chủ động). Dịch nghĩa: Phòng thí nghiệm AI nhờ kỹ sư kiểm thử hệ thống dữ liệu mới.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original one. The company will make all employees use AI tools.
options: A. All employees will made to use AI tools.
B. All employees will be made use AI tools.
C. All employees will be made to use AI tools.
D. All employees will have made use AI tools.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: make sb do sth → be made to do sth. Dịch nghĩa: Tất cả nhân viên sẽ được yêu cầu sử dụng công cụ AI.
